The '''Assassin's Guild''', sometimes spelled '''Assassins Guild''', was an organization whose members were [[Assassin/Legends|professional killers]] who performed contract terminations. The guild had different sub-guilds, like the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] division. The leaders and best members formed the so-called [[Elite Circle]]. Members were voted into the circle by their peers. [[Keluda]] was a member.

A team of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned members of the Guild supported Imperial [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Freja Covell]]'s forces during the [[Battle of Archais]], fighting three [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] units.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Gallandro-EU.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gallandro , an enemy of the Assassin's Guild.]]
Sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the guild took a contract on the gunslinger [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]]. This contract became the only known one they ever defaulted on after Gallandro personally killed half their [[Elite Circle]] and assorted journeymen and apprentices.

==Behind the scenes==
While "Assassins" is spelled in a plural form (without an apostrophe) in ''[[The Weapons Master!]]'', later comics [[Star Wars (1977) 48|''The Third Law'']] and [[Star Wars: Republic: Honor and Duty|''Honor and Duty'']] spell it in a possessive form (with an apostrophe). Presumably, they are both the same group.
